download_extract_ted_talks: download and extract the TED talks multilingual dataset tarball to a specified directory
read_multilingual_corpus: use MultiLingualAlignedCorpusReader to read and parse TED talk aligned corpus files for multiple language pairs
extract_bitext_pairs: extract bilingual sentence pairs for a source-target language pair and save train, test, and dev splits
extract_english_sentences: extract all English sentences from TED talk TSV files across train, dev, and test splits
detokenize_corpus_file: detokenize a tokenized corpus file using the Moses detokenizer for a specified language
